    FileDetails.Row
    One label/value row in the properties view.

    One entry in a FileSystem listing — local or remote.
    FileOrder.SortKey
    The column a user can sort a listing by (matches the FileBrowserPane table columns).
    FileSystem
    A navigable file system backing one pane of the DualPaneBrowser — either the local disk (LocalFileSystem) or a remote service (SFTP/FTP).
    FileTransfer
    Moves bytes between the local disk and a remote service (SFTP/FTP) for the two-pane browser.
    OverwriteResolver
    Decides, for each target file that already exists, whether the transfer should overwrite it or skip it — honouring "…all" answers for the remainder of the batch.
    OverwriteResolver.Action
    The resolved per-file action.
    OverwriteResolver.Choice
    The answers a user can give when a target file already exists.
    PathBookmarks
    An ordered, path-unique list of directory bookmarks for a file pane ("favourite" folders the user can jump back to).
    PathBookmarks.Bookmark
    One saved location: a display label for a directory path.
    PathCrumbs.Crumb
    One breadcrumb: the label shown to the user and the full path it navigates to.
    QuickView.Kind
    How a file may be opened in the quick-view dialog.
    ResumePlan.Action
    What to do with a destination file that already holds some bytes.
    ResumePlan.Plan
    A verdict plus the byte offset to start from (0 unless the action is ResumePlan.Action.RESUME_FROM).
    RetryPolicy
    Auto-retry rule for transfers that fail with a transient error: how many attempts to make in total and how long to back off between them (exponential, capped).
    SameSideMove.Move
    One planned rename: item moves from from to to.
    SavedSessions
    An ordered, name-unique list of saved connection profiles ("sessions") for a file-style connector, plus the last local/remote directory each one was left in — the WinSCP/MobaXterm "quick connect to a server and land where I was" behaviour.
    SavedSessions.Session
    One saved profile.

    The reconciliation strategy chosen by the user.
    SyncPlanner.Op

    A specific way a transfer failed verification.

    Transfer direction relative to the two-pane browser (local ⇄ remote).

    Receives queue change notifications (off any thread — UI listeners must marshal to FX).
